context: Wave 1 T7: hygiene batch B shipped — MetricEntry gains response_bytes/result_count/scope captured at the instrumentation seam (S4-4, the audit's highest-value-per-line ask); StoreSet exposes the raw sqlite handle; housekeeping execute runs wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) reported as wal_checkpointed; index.ts registers beforeExit/SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers that close the db (close checkpoints the WAL) with explicit conventional exit codes.
